## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest tests/` passes with the 100% coverage gate
- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .` and `mypy --strict .` are clean
- [ ] A change to one dashboard was made in the other too (or is explained here), with tests for both
- [ ] A fix comes with a test that fails when the fix is reverted
- [ ] Test data and docs use placeholders only (`my-api`, `feature/example`) - no real project, branch or path
